title: More -ma words, este / ese, la mano, manejar, la foto

cards.title: Greek -ma words: masculine
cards.body: Esquema (from 'scheme') means outline or diagram; note the extra e before sc-.

cards.title: el planeta: masculine with -a
cards.body: Most -o words are masculine and -a words feminine, with some exceptions.

cards.title: ese / esa = that
cards.body: Remove the t from este / esta.

examples.en: I don't want that car because it's very big.
examples.es: No quiero ese auto porque es muy grande.

cards.title: la mano = the hand
cards.body: Feminine despite the -o. Man- means hand in English words too: manual, manuscript, maintain (mantener), manage.

cards.title: manejar = to manage / handle / drive
cards.body: 'Manage' once meant handling horses; in some Latin American countries manejar means to drive.

examples.en: Can you give me a hand?
You should give me a hand.

cards.title: la foto, la moto
cards.body: These are short for la fotografía and la motocicleta, so they keep la. Tomar (or sacar) una foto = take a photo.

examples.en: I'd like to take a photo, but I don't have my camera.
examples.es: Me gustaría tomar una foto, pero no tengo mi cámara.
